# QuoteCue

> QuoteCue is a free, open-source Chrome and Microsoft Edge extension for attaching private annotations to selected text in ChatGPT, Claude, DeepSeek, and Kimi answers, then compiling those notes into one focused follow-up message.

Official website: https://quotecue.xingkaixin.me/
English page: https://quotecue.xingkaixin.me/en/
Japanese page: https://quotecue.xingkaixin.me/ja/
Source code: https://github.com/xingkaixin/QuoteCue
Extension privacy policy: https://github.com/xingkaixin/QuoteCue/blob/main/PRIVACY.md

## What QuoteCue does

- Select part of an AI answer and attach an optional annotation.
- Keep multiple annotations anchored to their original passages.
- Compile every selected passage and annotation into one numbered follow-up.
- Preserve a draft until a matching sent message is confirmed.

## Supported services

- ChatGPT at chatgpt.com
- Claude at claude.ai
- DeepSeek at chat.deepseek.com
- Kimi at www.kimi.com

## Product direction

QuoteCue is being developed as a reliable annotation layer across AI chat services: it should keep annotations attached to the intended source text, protect unfinished drafts, and turn several focal points into one clear follow-up without interrupting the conversation.

## Latest product update

Version 0.3.2 was released on 2026-09-05.

- The landing page was redesigned with an interactive flow hero, themed backgrounds, and multi-language product updates.
- Send confirmations are strictly scoped to their originating conversation to protect unsent drafts during fast switching.
- Extension and website interfaces transitioned to a refined Phosphor icon set.

## Privacy facts

- The QuoteCue extension operates no developer-controlled server.
- Identified-conversation drafts stay in browser-local extension storage.
- The extension requests only the storage permission and access to the four supported hosts.
- Current-version drafts expire after 30 days without an update.
- The extension itself collects no analytics. The product website uses self-hosted, cookie-free Umami for pageview analytics and supports Cloudflare Web Analytics for aggregate performance measurement. Website analytics do not include annotation or demo input content.

Last updated: 2026-09-05
